items.title: Night light and keep awake
items.text: Warmer colours in the evening (Super + Ctrl + N), and no lock or sleep while you present (Super + Ctrl + I).

items.title: Printing, scanning and USB drives
items.text: Printers and scanners work without drivers, and USB drives open by themselves. Settings → Printers and scanners.

items.title: Every app kept up to date
items.text: Flatpak apps are updated every day, firmware updates are offered, and you can undo an update from Settings → Updates.

items.title: Screens and the lid
items.text: Super + P duplicates or extends your screen; closing the lid with a monitor plugged in keeps working.

items.title: More in Settings
items.text: Date and time, Sharing, Users and sign-in, and apps that start on login.

items.title: The command menu and a smarter launcher
items.text: Super + Alt + Space: every system action in one keyboard menu. The launcher finds settings, windows and files too; ? searches the web.
